inputs: Ask me for: product + URL, 8 to 12 UI states that tell its story, the real data shown in each state, brand colors + fonts + one accent, a royalty-free track near 120 BPM (or "synthesize"), formats. Do not invent any of these. If I skip one, tell me the default you will use.
direction: Product-film UI motion. One container never cuts: every state is the same element changing size, radius and fill while its content swaps behind a short blur. A cursor drives every change. Warm neutral canvas, one accent. Springs with at most a tiny overshoot. Banned: bouncy easing, glows, gradients on UI chrome, particle bursts, dead time.
structure: 120 BPM, 8 bars, something happens on every beat. logo → CTA button → email field (typed) → loader → success check → dashboard card → chart draws itself → tooltip on hover → ⌘K palette → toast → logo.
build: 1. films//index.html, one canvas, window.seek(t). No CSS transitions, timers or carried state. 2. lib/motion.js closed-form springs. A value with many targets = M.track (one spring per change). 3. Text inside a morphing container enters after the morph starts, leaves before the next (M.swapAlpha). 4. Tab indicators: leading and trailing edges on different springs so they stretch (M.indicator). 5. Beat grid from beats.json. Start on a downbeat. UI sounds on measured beats. 6. node render.mjs at 60 fps, 4 subframes blended for motion blur.
gotchas: Never use will-change on anything the camera scales (blurry text). The last frame must equal the first, cursor position and velocity included (check out/seam.png).
start: Ask for the inputs, then show me the state list on the beat grid before writing code.
